title: Throughput
hook: Longer hours won't fix it. One useless step is slowing everything down.
statement: Speed of output beats amount of effort.
explainer: Clients see throughput, not effort. Cut one step before trying to rush.
sop: Cut or batch steps that add nothing.
equation_example: Output 12 projects ÷ Time 30 days = 0.4 a day. Raise it without adding hours.
question: Name the one step you could cut tomorrow.
closing_statement: Cut the step. Don't rush it.
